title: A Unique VTIMEZONE Exists for Every Referenced TZID

citations.verbatim_quote: An individual "VTIMEZONE" calendar component MUST be specified for each unique "TZID" parameter value specified in the iCalendar object.

statement: Every VTIMEZONE component carries a unique non-empty TZID, and for every TZID referenced by DTSTART, DTEND, DUE, RECURRENCE-ID, RDATE or EXDATE of any component, the calendar contains a VTIMEZONE with that TZID.
rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.2.19 (and Section 3.6.5) requires one individual VTIMEZONE per unique TZID in the iCalendar object. Edits that introduce a new zone must add its VTIMEZONE without duplicating existing definitions (R-L5-005, R-L5-006).

positive_examples.name: floating_needs_none
positive_examples.description: Floating and UTC need no VTIMEZONE.

negative_examples.name: unknown_tzid_without_vtimezone
negative_examples.description: Unrecognized TZID still requires a matching VTIMEZONE.

negative_examples.name: duplicate_vtimezone
negative_examples.description: Duplicate VTIMEZONE components for the same TZID.

audit_notes: Scenario vectors elide VTIMEZONE components unless the scenario is about them (schema convention), so this invariant is applied to complete store states only (applies_to_scenario_vectors=false).
